say: Retrying means trying again. It helps when a connection drops for a moment.

say: But thousands of apps trying again instantly, over and over, can overwhelm the server. That's a retry storm.

say: Fix one: stop when it works, or after three retries.

say: Fix two: wait longer each time. One second, then two, then four, so the server can recover.

say: Fix three: add a little randomness to each wait, so the apps don't all come back together.
